findings.message: run_pathway_pilot invokes run_pathway_next twice in its no-work-item branch; the first call logs a recommendation row that is never acted on, corrupting the follow-through metric denominator. Fix: split compute vs persist in run_pathway_nex
findings.resolution: Split run_pathway_next into compute_pathway_next (pure, no ledger write/no render) + persist_pathway_next (assigns rec id, renders report, appends the one follow-through row). run_pathway_next = persist(compute(...)); pathway-pilot's no-work-item branch now runs the dry pass via compute_pathway_next and persists exactly once after work-start. Regression test test_pathway_pilot_logs_one_recommendation_per_enrollment asserts the ledger gains exactly one row per enrollment; suite 537/537 green (2026-07-11).

findings.message: redact_obj exempts ANY 64-hex value from redaction (value-based, documented as deliberate). A hex-encoded 256-bit secret (openssl rand -hex 32) passes redaction untouched. Decide: key-suffix (_sha256/_digest/_hash) + value shape, or keep an
findings.resolution: Tightened to key-suffix + value conjunction (2026-07-11): exemption now requires the key to end in _sha256/_digest/_hash/_fingerprint AND the value to be 64-hex. All persisted digest fields verified to use compliant names (artifact_sha256, verify_stdout_sha256, verifier_source_sha256). Hex-encoded 256-bit secrets under any other key now hit the 64-char entropy pattern. Test test_redact_obj_exempts_only_real_sha256_digests extended; suite 538/538 green.

findings.message: pathway-next silently routes on work_items[0] when a project has multiple active outcomes; the tiebreak is undocumented and the other outcome is invisible in next_command. Emit a warning finding or sort by risk/updated_at.

Canary mutant restore runs in a finally block but has no on-disk journal; SIGKILL/power loss between mutate and restore leaves the mutant on disk. Consider a sibling backup file swept at next CLI start.

run_work_close passes itinerary/outcome_profile/risk_overlays with empty-collection defaults into update_work_item; if summary_item were ever empty this would overwrite persisted values. Pass only keys present in summary_item.
